meta.title: Implement redraw debounce
meta.body_summary: Add redraw debounce logic using a 100ms delay to prevent terminal overload from repeated redraw events.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added 100ms redraw debounce; reviewer bolinfest requested lock-scope improvement and subjective feel check; fixed and merged in ~2.6 hours with no benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 526 changed lines across 17 files, this is a small-to-medium change by absolute volume, though the core debounce logic is only ~50 lines in app.rs/app_event.rs. It fits a small-step incremental performance enhancement that was merged after addressing design feedback on lock scoping.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer requested moving an attribute to just above its usage and restructured lock acquisition to reduce lock hold time, offering a suggested code block.
review_details.performance_claim: Debouncing redraw events with 100ms delay to prevent repeated terminal redraws from overwhelming the system.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully implemented a TUI debounce mechanism in Rust, handling app event propagation and lock usage, but required human review to refine lock scoping and code placement.

detection_detail.code_reading: bolinfest reviewed the lock and attribute placement, providing a suggestion to reduce lock hold time.
detection_detail.manual_feel_testing: bolinfest asked if the app felt more responsive before approving.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or exact repro steps; performance evidence was a subjective feel check.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, the author adopted the suggested lock scoping and code placement, and the PR was approved.

core_change_summary.description: In codex-rs/tui/src/app.rs, implemented schedule_redraw() that uses a Mutex<bool> flag and thread::sleep with a 100ms constant to coalesce redraws; added AppEvent::Redraw in app_event.rs; replaced direct .send(AppEvent::Redraw) calls in bottom_pane/mod.rs, chatwidget.rs, and status_indicator_widget.rs with schedule_redraw().
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merging main introduced unrelated changes to other files (mcp_connection_manager, .vscode config, etc.) which are not part of the debounce feature.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add redraw debounce with schedule_redraw() and AppEvent::Redraw, update widget calls.
Merge main: incorporate unrelated main changes.
Review feedback: move attribute and restructure lock acquisition to reduce hold time.
Fix clippy and clone usage after review.

review_signals.summary: Requested to move #[allow(clippy::unwrap_used)] attribute to just above its usage.
Suggested restructuring lock acquisition within a block to reduce lock hold time with a code suggestion.
Asked if the app felt any more or less responsive after the change.
Approved after review feedback was addressed.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial debounce implementation.
Reviewer bolinfest CHANGES_REQUESTED with lock scoping improvement and code placement request, and a subjective responsiveness question.
Author merged main, applied suggested lock restructuring, and fixed clippy/clone issues.
Reviewer approved; PR merged after ~2.6 hours.
